description: This file defines the BasketWithItemsSpecification class, a specification used to query baskets with items in the eShopOnWeb application. It includes constructors for filtering by basket ID or buyer ID and includes related items.

classes.name: BasketWithItemsSpecification
classes.description: A specification for querying baskets along with their items, based on basket ID or buyer ID.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the specification with a basket ID filter.
